name: Methyl gluceth
description: Methyl gluceth (CAS 69708-57-2 ), commercially available as Macbiobride MG 10E, is a glucose-derived polyol ether used in personal care and cosmetic formulations. It functions simultaneously as a humectant, emulsifier, and solvent carrier. This versatile ingredient allows formulators to address multiple performance requirements within a single ingredient. In skin and hair care products, it attracts and retains moisture in the formulation matrix while improving skin feel. The compound significantly enhances spreadability across various applications. Emulsion-based products such as lotions, creams, and conditioners benefit from its ability to stabilize oil-water systems without heavy emulsifier loads. As a solvent carrier, it aids in solubilizing active ingredients and fragrance components in both rinse-off and leave-on formulations. This ensures a consistent delivery of functional components throughout the product lifecycle. In home care and industrial cleaning products, it contributes to surfactant system compatibility. It helps maintain solution stability across varying pH ranges, making it suitable for diverse chemical environments and cleaning tasks. Methyl gluceth is supplied as a clear to slightly viscous liquid. It is available in cosmetic-grade and technical-grade specifications to meet the requirements of personal care manufacturers and industrial formulators respectively. Packaging is typically offered in drums and intermediate bulk containers suited to commercial production volumes.
